title: Circuit output evaluation
statement: Given a multi-output directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs and an input assignment $x$, its evaluation is the list formed, in the specified output order, by reading each output vertex's value from the circuit's value list; if an index has no value in that list, the corresponding output is false.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-output directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs
An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs
caveat: The circuit value operation is not defined in the provided material.
